findings.quote: we can always find a subset of the first $ i $ elements that sums to a value in $[190, 210]$.
findings.reason: False: take five 23s and four 24s. Their total is 211, while every proper subset has sum at most 211−23=188. Thus no subset lies in [190,210], disproving the asserted sufficiency of N=10.

reason: The ten-21s example correctly proves N≥10, but the sufficiency claim and final answer are false.
unresolved_obligations: Determine the actual smallest N and prove that it guarantees a suitable subset for every admissible list.
